spans.s:
ईर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excited.
—ईर्य-ता, f., Ved.
the condition of one who is to be excited.

ईर्या, f. wandering about as a religious mendicant.
—ईर्या-पथ, अस्, m. the observances of a religious
mendicant; the four positions of the body, viz.
going, standing upright, sitting and lying down.
